items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Man, he used to get Dick Wellstood.

ctx.x: I really don't know. I mean, he had problems with Louis, too, you know. I just really could never figure him out, you know. He always thought somebody was plotting against him or something. Like he would tell me, he said 'You ought to watch the trumpet ...(?)..., because they got black hearts' -- they're evil, you know.
And he always would pick on piano players, too. Man, he used to get Dick Wellstood.
